name: hybrid-local-router
description: Five skills for cost- and time-efficient work, from strategy to execution: roadmap tracks Now/Next/Later initiatives in ROADMAP.md; grouping breaks an initiative or backlog into value-ranked groups and dispatches each to the cheapest sufficient tier and effort level (local model / Haiku / Sonnet / Opus); local-offload routes boilerplate/refactor sub-tasks to a local LLM (Exo, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or llama.cpp, auto-detected) with usage tracking (GET /stats) to show estimated $ saved, and can bootstrap a backend from scratch on a new machine; daisy-chain adds a device to an existing Exo cluster with one consolidated confirmation instead of per-step prompts; handoff checkpoints long-running batches so they survive context compaction or a closed session.
